notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light Patch 1.14
notes.notes:
Update 1.14:


 Adjusted level gameplay and difficulty slightly
 Balanced abilities
 Fixed inconsistencies with power rune ability stats
 General bugfixes
 Added changelog ingame

notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light - Patch to version 1.13
notes.notes:
A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light v1.13 brings minor changes and some bugfixes / improvements on the levels. The credit list has been updated, enemy placements and gameplay elements in certain levels have been changed to make the level more enjoyable and issues with Steam achievements and stats should have been fixed. Achievements and stats should now sync themselves between your savefile and Steam.

What's coming next?
There will be some more minor changes to level design according to feedback and a slight rework of the animations. Stay tuned!

notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light v1.12 - Day 1 Patch
notes.notes: v1.12 - Day 1 Patch is now here for "A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light". Fixed a visual bug for enemies in level 2-2, some difficulty patches and adjusted the playbackspeed of some animations.

notes.title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light Demo Version Update
notes.notes: Typo in tutorial section of the game fixed and improved footstep sounds depending on ground material. Also fixed some minor issues with the first two levels.
